_README: The 20-ticker golden universe for the hardening run (Phase 0.1).
Each entry declares the facts the invariant suite needs to judge a metric:
entity_type drives metric applicability (a bank has no meaningful current
ratio or EV/EBITDA - defect #16); reporting_currency differs from
listing_currency for the IT names, which is the whole of defect #14;
benchmark is the index beta MUST be regressed against (defect #11 - the
providers regress NSE names against the S&P, which is why Indian betas
These are identity/classification facts, not market data. They are stable
and verifiable from the exchange listing, so they are safe to assert in
tests. Actual PRICES and FUNDAMENTALS are NOT here - those come from
scripts/capture_fixtures.py, which must be run on a networked machine.
has_promoter=false is the assertion behind defect #16: HDFC/ICICI/AXIS are
professionally managed with no promoter, so a 0.2% reading is not a small
promoter - it is a false claim. SBIN is the true-positive control: the
Government of India IS the promoter at ~57%.
